items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And I was playing with Alex Jackson's band.

ctx.x: I worked a couple of gigs in Chicago, but (unintelligible) in the union. You go around and you meet musicians wherever you go. Because they can coach you and steer you around. It was strange for me, in those cities. I'd never been there before. But when you meet musicians and they know you -- and they had heard of us. They hear about you, you'd be surprised. If I was out West I'd know about fellows in New York.
And I liked it, it was an experience for me. And I was playing with Alex Jackson's band. And -- one nighters.
